correctness.rationale: Unique rooted infection paths and conditional common-source Bernoulli trials imply E I_v=q^depth. Condition on non-root edges; convexity of E phi(c+sum_j A_j Bernoulli(p)) follows from nonnegative mixed second differences. For incomparable pair (u,v), their two path edges leaving LCA contribute E P² instead of q²; other sources each contribute q. The resulting exact variance-index identity, q exponent, convex-order dominance and star/path bounds follow. Independently exact checked 3-leaf star P in {1/4,3/4} against q=1/2: variances 9/8 vs 3/4, all discrete stop losses. Analytical argument, not this check, covers arbitrary trees.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are bounded; full quantifiers depend on inspected analytic or finite-exhaustive reduction arguments.

evidence: Wilkinson and Sharkey prove monotonicity/comparison for infection reaching specified subsets under infectious-period distributions.
